content: Monkeytype's own accuracy formula (per DeepWiki summary of test-stats.ts lines ~435-449): accuracy = 100 * correctChars / (correctChars + incorrectChars), defaulting to 100% when zero chars typed. This counts only the FINAL per-position outcome (like keebdrill's computeTrainerState.perCharStatus), NOT every attempt including corrected-over ones -- i.e. Monkeytype's accuracy does NOT put corrections in the denominator. keebdrill's METR-02/D-02 deliberately diverges from Monkeytype here per ROADMAP's explicit 'with corrections in the denominator' wording. General typing-test convention (TypingMaster, RapidTyping, generic typing-speed sites): accuracy = correct keystrokes / total keystrokes x 100; whether backspalce/delete keystrokes are counted in the denominator varies by implementation and is not standardized across tools.
